before.explanation: Connects possible frame/function restoration with named BRCA2 model evidence, and removes universal clinical-response or treatment-selection conclusions. Source scope: ClinVar and RefSeq identifiers, MedlinePlus molecular-effect explanations, Sakai 2008 abstract and Sakai 2009 targeted primary text. No universal prevalence or treatment-switch claim.
